headline: Sort: Remove What Does Not Belong
alternativeHeadline: The first S, and the first time you move a thing. Test every object against one question and remove what does not belong.
description: Sort is the first S and the first physical move in the book. Hold every object up to one question, does this help the space do its job, and carry out everything that answers no. This chapter defines Sort, gives the One Question as the test, walks a worked pass through the entryway drop zone, reframes removing as an address change rather than throwing away, and shows the friction meter move for the first time.
keywords: first step to declutter a room
